label: Окно
description: A 10-sentence usage card for окно: each line is a complete everyday sentence drilling one case (opening, looking, room placement).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject + state. 1. 'Окно' is the neuter subject in the nominative case (окно). 2. 'Открыто' is the short-form neuter predicate agreeing with it. 3. A clean noun-plus-state sentence for the base form.

missions.phrase: Я смотрю в окно на улицу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 1. 'В окно' uses the accusative (окно, identical to nominative for this neuter noun) to mark motion of the gaze. 2. 'Смотрю' is a first-person present verb. 3. A simple, highly reusable everyday line.

Strategic focus: Genitive of location near a landmark. 1. 'У окна' uses the genitive (окна) to anchor the object in the room. 2. 'Кресло' is a useful household noun. 3. Trains pairing nouns with spatial relations.

Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 1. 'Закрываю' is a common first-person verb. 2. 'Окно' stays in the accusative as the direct object (окно, neuter = nominative form). 3. An everyday home sentence worth memorizing.

missions.phrase: В этой комнате очень большое окно.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative with neuter agreement. 1. 'Большое' is the neuter adjective matching the nominative noun 'окно'. 2. 'В этой комнате' places it in a clear household scene. 3. A basic description frame.

Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 1. 'Из окна' uses the genitive (окна) to mark the source of the view. 2. 'Видно' is a common impersonal construction. 3. 'Двор' gives the line a concrete outside image.

Strategic focus: Instrumental of position. 1. 'Перед окном' uses the instrumental (окном) for an 'in front of' relation. 2. 'Стол' keeps the scene concrete. 3. A short, easy-to-visualize spatial sentence.

Strategic focus: Instrumental viewpoint. 1. 'За окном' uses the instrumental (окном) in a very natural Russian frame. 2. 'Идёт дождь' is high-frequency weather language. 3. Excellent for everyday description.

Strategic focus: Accusative object of an infinitive. 1. 'Мыть окно' keeps the noun in the accusative (окно) as object of the infinitive. 2. 'Нужно' gives the line a clean necessity feel. 3. A useful chores sentence.

missions.phrase: Рядом с окном стоит яркая лампа.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental of relative position. 1. 'Рядом с окном' uses the instrumental (окном) for a precise 'next to' relation. 2. 'Стоит лампа' creates a clear scene. 3. Ideal for room description.
